physarum_heritage_crossing_count.formula: g1 hard-constraint protection_scope crossing count (always 0) of the real Physarum network; observed at method level only, not an independent site heritage-protection metric
assumptions: Off-site method validation only. The public site package provides no official heritage geometry with a non-default heritage_factor, so the four-objective f3 (heritage impact) degenerates to f2 (cost) — i.e. f3≡f2. The recorded 0 is therefore the g1 hard-constraint behavior (protection_scope crossing count is always 0), NOT an independent heritage-protection compliance conclusion for this site.
physarum_heritage_crossing_count.note: Provisional; off-site method validation only. Does not constitute an in-site heritage-protection compliance conclusion.
